171:t_1:169.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Fight, $$キラ$$, to stop that from happening!」

171:t_1:170.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Please go, $$キラ$$! Add my wishes to your strength!」

171:t_1:177.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Hehe... My declaration must have set history in motion.」

171:t_1:178.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$プラント$$ and $$ジオン$$ are both people of space... Both will awaken as a new humanity...」

171:t_1:179.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Once someone unites that power, everything will fall into place.」

171:t_1:180.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You will play that role.」

171:t_2:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...So that's what lay behind the creation of $$コーディネイター$$s.」

171:t_2:5.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「$$ザフト$$'s leadership already knows the truth and has agreed to support $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

171:t_2:6.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Even the $$クライン派$$, which opposed $$ジオン$$, has joined them. $$プラント$$ is now wholly committed to war with the $$地球連邦$$.」

171:t_2:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Where are $$イザーク$$ and $$ディアッカ$$?」

171:t_2:8.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Their whereabouts are unknown... I can't imagine them agreeing with $$ザフト$$'s current methods...」

171:t_2:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「We think they've either been detained or deserted on their own.」

171:t_2:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So $$ザフト$$'s leadership knew the truth before $$ラクス$$ and had contacted $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

171:t_2:11.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I think former $$クロノ$$ Reformists among the pro-war faction were involved in that.」

171:t_2:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And now even $$サイデリアル$$ is involved...」

171:t_2:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But isn't that contradictory? ...The $$クロノ$$ Reformists oppose the Conservatives, who are connected to $$サイデリアル$$...」

171:t_2:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Conservatives target $$スペースノイド$$s, while $$サイデリアル$$, which backs them, supports $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$プラント$$.」

171:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I think the key to that is $$フル・フロンタル$$'s phrase, 'successors of Earth's humanity.'」

171:t_2:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ normally backs the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, but is probably weighing them against the $$スペースノイド$$s they should be attacking.」

171:t_2:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They'll recognize the winner as the successor to Earth's humanity.」

171:t_2:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They're making Earthlings fight each other...!」

171:t_2:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ジェミニス$$ did the same thing. Our lives and beliefs probably mean nothing to them.」

171:t_2:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And we're letting them manipulate us...!」

171:t_2:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Has $$フル・フロンタル$$ not noticed that...?)

171:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
(No... He's even more cunning than $$シャア$$... That's impossible...)

171:t_2:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「To put an end to this quagmire...」

171:t_2:25.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have to defeat the $$新地球皇国$$, the source of it all.」

171:t_2:26.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is moving its main forces from the $$翠の地球$$ to the $$蒼の地球$$.」

171:t_2:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$セツコ$$... Were you on the $$翠の地球$$?」

171:t_2:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... I was with $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$... and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

171:t_2:30.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It wasn't for very long, but we fought $$サイデリアル$$ with him on the $$翠の地球$$.」

171:t_2:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Keep your head up, $n. We don't have time to hang our heads.」

171:t_2:33.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$シン$$ is right. If there's a path before us, we'll follow it.」

171:t_2:34.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「$$キラ$$... Is $$ラクス$$ safe...?」

171:t_2:35.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried, but $$アスラン$$, Captain $$バルトフェルド$$, and the others are in $$プラント$$, too.」

171:t_2:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Didn't you know he'd become like that?」

171:t_2:40.en:
$$シン$$
「With his health problems, he stayed out of $$ザフト$$ and was resting.」

171:t_2:44.en:
$$キラ$$
「...I'll explain. He... $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$, is a clone of a certain person.」

171:t_2:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
(He's a clone... like $$マリーダ$$...)

171:t_2:46.en:
$$キラ$$
「And because of a chromosomal abnormality, he doesn't have long to live...」

171:t_2:48.en:
$$シン$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$... is trying to create a future for $$コーディネイター$$s with what little life he has left...」

171:t_2:50.en:
$$シン$$
「I know. ...I won't accept a future built on war.」

171:t_2:51.en:
$$シン$$
「If $$レイ#pt136$$ has chosen that, I'll stop him with words, without fighting.」

171:t_2:52.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You can do that, $$シン$$... You've overcome your sorrow.」

171:t_2:54.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You've still got a soft spot for $$セツコ$$.」

171:t_2:56.en:
$n
「You're looking at another woman right in front of your girlfriend... That's awfully unfaithful, $$シン$$.」

171:t_2:58.en:
$$セツコ$$
(He's the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$...)

171:t_2:59.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said... that he would save us...)

171:t_2:60.en:
$$オットー$$
「We just received a transmission from the $$マクロス・クォーター$$. They're heading here from the $$翠の地球$$, too.」

171:t_2:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「And they're bringing the new fighting strength we've been waiting for.」

171:t_2:63.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Once we join them, we'll begin preparing to attack $$ラース・バビロン$$, the $$新地球皇国$$'s imperial capital.」

171:t_2:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So we're making a concentrated strike at the heart of $$サイデリアル$$...」

171:t_2:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's a battle with Earth's fate at stake...」

171:t_2:67.en:
$n
「Just wait, $$サイデリアル$$... We'll make you pay for everything you've done... to every person on Earth.」

171:t_10:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I... may have said something I shouldn't have to $$ハマーン・カーン$$...」

171:t_10:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't worry about it. I did the same thing.」

kept_omissions: 171:t_2:24: Sumeragi states the purpose of ending the quagmire; Zero supplies the main clause in25, so the original cut remains.
171:t_2:37: Kira begins identifying the problem; Shinn supplies Rey in38, preserving the interrupted identification.
171:t_2:43: Shinn hesitates at being asked whether Rey is sick; Kira explains instead in44.
171:t_2:47: The listener begins inferring Rey's limited lifespan but stops before stating the inference.
